subject: Midcycle metering bucket shift — provisional invoice spike
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soren Holm <soren@clearaudio.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Midcycle metering bucket shift — provisional invoice spike

Hi Soren,

We flagged a sharp jump on the provisional invoice for your account covering Aug 12–24 (roughly 3x expected monthly run‑rate). Before we escalate this publicly, can you confirm whether you ran any large replays or reprocessing jobs on your end over that window?

What would help on our side: a short sample export (CSV) of request_ids and timestamps for Aug 12–24 (or the job ID if you ran a replay), and any internal notes about backfills or ingestion restarts. If you prefer, attach a 100‑row sample with the most frequent request_ids.

Two asks from our side:
- Can you pause any automated replays while we triage so we don't compound the delta?
- Would you be open to a provisional credit while we complete the forensic? We want to avoid a collections hit mid-investigation.

Looping in your billing alias matters only if you want a contact there: we can CC them once we have the sample.

Thanks — I want to get this resolved quickly.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555‑0187

Attachment: (none yet)
From: Soren Holm <soren@clearaudio.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:05:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Midcycle metering bucket shift — provisional invoice spike

Ben — thanks for the heads up. We saw the same numbers on our side this morning. We did run a backfill job on Aug 18 that reprocessed a stale queue; early post‑run checks suggested de‑duping worked but we did discover a second replay that unintentionally overlapped with the first. We are still digging into why both replays ran.

I attached a small sample export (clearaudio_metering_sample.csv) showing duplicated request_ids and timestamps clustered around Aug 18–19. Also attaching the provisional invoice we received today (provisional_invoice_0826.pdf) so you can see the line items.

We’ll pause any further replays until you confirm. If your team needs any additional exports (token-level or raw request payloads) let us know and we’ll pull them.

—Soren
Soren Holm
Head of Platform, ClearAudio
soren@clearaudio.ai
Attachment: clearaudio_metering_sample.csv (CSV, 42 KB); provisional_invoice_0826.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soren Holm <soren@clearaudio.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 14:20:33 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Midcycle metering bucket shift — provisional invoice spike

Laura / Vanessa — forwarding Soren’s sample and the provisional invoice. Preliminary look: duplicated request_ids clustered around Aug 18–19 line up with a replay pattern. We should:

1) Place the provisional invoice on hold for collections (pending forensics).
2) Run token/request_id crosswalk between our ingest logs and ClearAudio’s sample to confirm duplication source.
3) Consider provisional credit to avoid payment disruption — Soren suggested they'd pause replays.

Soren — thanks for sharing. We’ll scope the size/timeframe and propose a provisional credit amount (we should avoid pre‑committing until we have the crosswalk).

Laura — can your team propose a provisional credit % or dollar amount policy for jumps caused by customer replays where our metering picks them up as new tokens? Also, VAT treatment question — if we issue a credit, how should we handle the VAT line for EU customers (this one’s US so lower priority, but want consistent policy).

Vanessa — can finance temporarily flag DR-4891 in HubSpot to block automated collection, and prepare an evidence request to ClearAudio for a full export?

Thanks,
Ben
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:00:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Midcycle metering bucket shift — provisional invoice spike

Thanks Ben. Proposed path:

- Place invoice on collection hold until the forensic completes. I authorize a provisional credit up to 50% of the disputed delta if the forensics take longer than 72 hours, with final reconciliation once we have token/request_id confirmation. Provisional credit amount estimate: $8,400 (50% of disputed $16,800 delta).

- VAT handling: if customer is EU and we issued VAT on the original invoice we'd issue a corresponding VAT adjustment on the credit (reverse charge as applicable). For US customers we just apply the credit to next invoice; no VAT adjustment.

Vanessa — please open HubSpot ticket DR-4891 (Ben copied) and attach the forensic_checklist.md (summary checklist attached). Finance to mark invoice #INV-2247 as HOLD and prepare a provisional credit memo.

Soren — we’ll coordinate log requests; request: token-level sample for Aug 12–24 (first 10K lines ideally) and a short summary of any replay job IDs and timestamps.

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachment: forensic_checklist.md (text)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Soren Holm <soren@clearaudio.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 10:30:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Midcycle metering bucket shift — provisional invoice spike

All — updating with actions taken and next steps.

Actions executed:
- Placed INV-2247 (ClearAudio) on HOLD in billing pipeline; collections paused.
- Created HubSpot ticket DR-4891 and attached initial Soren sample.
- Initiated provisional credit memo for $8,400 against next cycle (we will reconcile in final forensic).
- Notified Compliance to review VAT implications (cc’d).

Soren — please confirm when you’ve paused replays and upload the full export to the secure share (https://redwood.share/forensics/DA-4891-export). Once we have the full export we’ll run the crosswalk and share token-level mismatch evidence. If you’re agreeable, sign the mutual action plan (link sent via DocuSign) so both teams can agree on replay pauses and evidence handoff timelines.

We aim to provide an interim summary within 72 hours and a final reconciliation within 10 business days.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Billing Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Attachment: mutual_action_plan_link.txt (DocuSign link)
